description: Plátce-DPH status from the ARES RZP record, cross-checked against the ARES DPH source flag. RZP is a HISTORICAL register (records can stop updating in 2016), so a positive here is not proof of current plátcost — the result carries registerState + caution when the two disagree. For a legally binding check use the MOF DPH register (ADISREG). Batch up to 20 IČOs.
name: check_vat
title: Czech VAT (DPH) status check
